parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top movable part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, typically circular and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, allowing liquid or soap to be dispensed through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, compressing the internal spring and drawing liquid upward through the pump tube.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head section includes the nozzle and upper housing of the dispenser, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal pump to the outside through the nozzle, ensuring controlled flow.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but is connected to the pressing lid, allowing internal fluid movement when the lid is pressed.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, cylindrical in shape and made of polyethylene plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid or soap that will be dispensed through the pump mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural support for the entire dispenser assembly.
